summary: StudentPrerequisites defines a comprehensive set of prerequisites for students, primarily focusing on immunizations, infection control, medical, confidentiality, and safety requirements. Requirements involve status codes, descriptions, dates, completion flags, and supporting notes. System logic supports workflows for updating student records, validating prerequisite data (e.g., expiry, format, completion), and managing exceptions for missing or out-of-range values. The model includes both English and French field variants to support bilingual display and logic.
purpose: To ensure students meet health, safety, and confidentiality requirements by tracking immunizations, infection control status, medical completion, and safety checklist items. The system provides workflows to capture, validate, and update these prerequisites for students, used by staff and system processes.

workflows.name: Immunization Update
steps: Collect immunization dates, status codes, notes.
Validate dates (not expired, correct format, within permitted range).

workflows.name: Infection Control Update
steps: Collect mask fit test dates, size codes, expiry dates, notes.
Validate mask fit and expiry dates, ensure expiry is after fit test and within acceptable timeframe.
Update StudentPrerequisite mask/infection control fields in DB.

workflows.name: Safety Checklist Update
steps: Update CRCStatusDate, IDCard, IDCardDate, WCB status, waiver dates.

workflows.name: Confidentiality & Consent Update
steps: Collect ConfidentialityForm completion, date received, notes, ConsentProgramID, ConsentObtainedDate.
Validate mandatory fields (program ID, obtained date must not be empty or invalid).
Handle consent expiry/un-expiry scenarios as needed.

business_rules: Dates may not exceed certain ranges (usually within 5 years; validation messages for violations).
Status codes must be valid, numeric, and align with described immunization/test status.
Completion flags (e.g., MedicalCompleted, ImmunizationFeePaid) must reflect underlying field values.
If a mask size is specified, a fit test date is required.
Expiry date must be after completed date.
Program and consent dates are mandatory for certain updates.
French and English descriptions are maintained separately for display/logic.
validations: Fit test date is required if mask size specified.
Dates must not be more than 5 years in the future.
Expiry date required if expiry years specified.
Expiry date must be on or after completed date.
Year fields must be within MIN_YEAR and MaxYear.
Medical completed dates must not be more than 5 years in the past.
Dates must be valid and formatted correctly.
calculations: Tetanus and Polio expiry date calculation (typically add 10 years to admin date if expiry date not specified).
Expiry close logic: mark expiry within 90 days as urgent.
Mask fit expiry calculation: check if expiry matches fit test plus 1 or 2 years.
conditions: If ConfidentialityForm not completed, default received date is today.
system_behavior: Add error messages for invalid fields, dates, or missing required information.
Procedure calls for record update: StudentDetailsImmunizationUpdate, StudentDetailsSafetyUpdate, StudentDetailsConfidentialityUpdate, etc.
Validations trigger exceptions; updates only proceed for valid records.
Support for bilingual field display and logic.
dependencies: DateFormatter utility for date conversion and formatting.
Database backend for record retrieval and update.
Status code tables for immunization, infection control, health, and safety.
exceptions: Invalid/missing dates, years outside allowed range, completion flags inconsistent with data trigger error messages.
Consent not valid without valid program or date.
content_gaps: Some workflows and business rules reference supporting utility classes and external resource files (e.g., DateFormatter, Resources) not included in the documents.
There is no explicit description of UI or integration points.
No sample data or input/output formats included.
No detailed error codes or full descriptions of status codes.
